summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7 filed an 8-K regarding upcoming auction-rate note auctions for its Class A-6B and A-6C notes. An affiliate of Navient Funding, LLC, the depositor, intends to submit a Hold Order for all outstanding Class A-6B notes it already holds and buy bids for Class A-6C notes at 30-day Average SOFR plus 1.50% per annum, while holding its current position. This is a routine operational notice for an asset-backed securities trust, not a special situation. No strategic transaction, corporate action, or change is involved; the filing merely discloses the affiliate's auction participation to support the auction mechanism.
